outcome: Accuracy of transvaginal ultrasound diagnosis for PCSD
Therapeutic efficacy/effective rate of hysteroscopy electrotomy
cohort: 25 patients with previous cesarean scar defect (PCSD) related clinical symptoms.
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound diagnosis for PCSD showed 88% accuracy, and hysteroscopy electrotomy was an effective treatment, particularly for PCSD patients with a single cesarean history and anteverted uterus position.
mod_finding: Hysteroscopy electrotomy demonstrated a significantly higher effective rate in patients with a single cesarean section (83.3%) compared to those with multiple cesarean sections (38.5%).
